description: Defines ASN.1 structures and classes related to 3GPP NR RRC BCCH-BCH messages, including sequence and choice types for message configuration and content.

classes.name: pdcch_cfg_sib1_s
classes.description: Structure representing PDCCH-ConfigSIB1 ASN.1 sequence with packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: mib_s
classes.description: Structure representing MIB ASN.1 sequence with nested options and sequence methods.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Class representing BCCH-BCH message type choice with methods to set and get message type, pack, unpack, and serialize to JSON.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_s
classes.description: Structure representing BCCH-BCH message ASN.1 sequence containing message type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit reference.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit reference.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type in bcch_bch_msg_type_c.

methods.name: set_mib
methods.description: Sets the message type to MIB in bcch_bch_msg_type_c.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension in bcch_bch_msg_type_c.
